name: Gizmo guide
author: Brett
description: Gizmo's narrated walkthroughs (walkthrough@1) in the console: ask him how to do something (Help → Ask Gizmo to show me…, gizmo.ask, or AmberX) and a small floating window shows each step with Next and Previous while the console moves there, highlights it and reads the step out loud. It never opens by itself on load; walkthroughs asked for from AmberX open on their own only with the opt-in switch. Reaches Gizmo through the axf.agents@1 capability (the Agent manager provides it; falls back to the old Molly add-on if Gizmo is off); AmberX's server asks through this plugin's /ask route. Folder and setting keys keep the molly-guide name so saved data stays.
